_comment: Every player-visible string, by key. Code calls Text.t("merc.died.title", {...}); no player-visible string lives in a script (04_GUARDRAILS.md B12). Schema: data/schema/text.schema.json.
slice.help: WASD or arrows: walk   Click: walk there   T: time of day   R: rain   F2: the map   F4: the company   F6: the hub   F5: play the loop   F1: hide help   F3: frame time
cast.orc.name: The Orc
cast.vampyr.name: The Vampyr
company.panel.title: The company ({count} of {cap})
company.panel.pick: Pick a mercenary to inspect them.
company.placeholder: Placeholder: the director has yet to write this mercenary.
company.xp: Experience {into} of {span} to the next level ({xp} in all)
enemy.bandit.name: Bandit
enemy.bandit_chief.name: Bandit chief
enemy.watchman.name: Watchman
enemy.watch_sergeant.name: Watch sergeant
cast.recruit_placeholder.name: Recruit (placeholder)
slice.injury.scarred_face: {name} carries a new scar across the face.
slice.arrive.title: The company arrives
slice.arrive.body: Mud, smoke and wary faces. Word is there is work, and a sellsword drinking alone at the inn.
slice.recruit.title: A recruit
slice.contract.title: The notice board
slice.contract.body: Bandits on the mill road. The miller pays for every one who stops robbing his carts.
slice.travel.title: The mill road
slice.travel.body: The light goes as you leave the town, and the rain comes in.
slice.gate.title: A lookout
slice.gate.body: A bandit lookout steps out of the hedge. Who talks to him, or do you fight?
slice.gate.success: {name} rolled {roll}, needing {need}: the lookout slips away into the dark. The band is shaken.
slice.gate.failure: {name} rolled {roll}, needing {need}: the lookout shouts the alarm and draws his blade.
slice.battle.move_hint: Click a cell to move, or choose:
slice.fate.title: The last bandit yields
slice.fate.body: He throws down his blade and kneels in the mud.
slice.return.title: Back in town
slice.return.unhurt: Everyone came back whole. This time.
slice.camp.title: Camp
slice.camp.body: The company rests, counts its coin and its scars, and talks about where to go next.
slice.done.title: End of the loop example
slice.done.body: Press F5 to play it again.
world.panel.title: The road
world.panel.body: Where does the company go? F2 or Escape closes the map.
world.panel.saved: Saved. The company picks up here next time.
world.panel.save_failed: The save could not be written.
world.choice.travel_one: To {site}, a day on the road
world.encounter.ambush.title: Ambush!
world.encounter.ambush.body: Armed men break from the verge on the road to {site}, on day {day}. There is no way round and no time to talk: they strike first.
world.encounter.patrol.title: A patrol
world.encounter.patrol.body: A patrol bars the road to {site}, on day {day}. The sergeant names a toll of {toll} supplies. Fight them, or pay and pass.
world.encounter.outcome.won: The company won the fight on the road and looted {supplies} supplies.
world.encounter.outcome.lost: The company lost the fight on the road and {supplies} supplies, and fell back to {site}.
world.encounter.outcome.paid: The company paid {supplies} supplies and the patrol let it pass.
hub.title: The hub, day {day}
hub.wages.owed: Wages owed: {owed} coin ({per_day} a day for {count} mercenaries). Days unpaid: {days}.
hub.away: Wages, contracts and hiring are done at the hub.
hub.contracts.title: Contracts
hub.contract.accept: Accept: {faction} wants the company at {site}. {reward} coin, by day {deadline}.
hub.recruits.title: Recruits (a hire costs {cost} coin)
hub.recruits.none: No one is looking for work.
hub.pack.title: The pack
hub.prisoner.title: A prisoner
hub.prisoner.body: A survivor of the fight is in the company's hands. What is done with them?
hub.prisoner.recruit: Offer them a place in the company
hub.memory.prisoner.release: {name} remembers the day the company let a prisoner walk away.
hub.memory.prisoner.ransom: {name} remembers the day the company sold a prisoner back for coin.
hub.memory.prisoner.execute: {name} remembers the day the company put a prisoner to death.
hub.memory.prisoner.recruit: {name} remembers the day the company took a prisoner on as one of its own.
injury.gash.name: a gash
injury.broken_arm.name: a broken arm
injury.lost_eye.name: a lost eye
injury.lost_eye.role: Fights half-blind: no longer trusted on the front line, he is better kept at the back.
chronicle.death: {name} died on day {day}, struck down by {cause}.
memory.comrade_died: I stood beside {name} when he fell on day {day}.
memory.captain_died: The captain {name} died on day {day}, and the company had to choose.
memory.dissent: I did not want {name} to lead us.
